title: Fully remote and hybrid work
goal: A practitioner can read this comparison at a glance: Fully remote and hybrid work.

rubric.must: The named scenario is visibly identified and its primary subject is clearly shown.
The picture visibly uses the required standard diagram structure and connected elements.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the comparison/double-bubble exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target clearly presents “Fully remote and hybrid work” as a double-bubble comparison. Labels are legible, and the connecting lines distinguish shared points from items unique to each work arrangement without visible overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: The title identifies the comparison, and the two central bubbles are labeled “Fully remote” and “Hybrid.”
Two central bubbles connect to three shared points between them and three unique points on each outer side.
The comparison reads clearly from Fully remote through the shared middle points to Hybrid, with unique points grouped beside each subject.
All labels are readable and positioned within their corresponding bubbles; the bottom captions identify the three groups.
Lines visibly connect each outer point to its intended subject and shared points to both subjects; no unintended cross-connections are apparent.
